dataset.name_ro: Structuri de primire turistica cu functiuni de cazare turistica pe tipuri de structuri, judete si localitati
dataset.name_en: Establishments of touristic reception with functions of tourists accommodation by type of establishment , counties and localities
dataset.definition_ro:
Structura de primire turistica cu functiuni de cazare turistica - orice constructie sau amenajare, care furnizeaza in mod permanent sau sezonier serviciul de cazare si alte servicii specifice pentru turisti.
Nu se cuprind in cercetarea statistica, structurile de primire turistica cu functiuni de cazare turistica cu o capacitate de cazare instalata de mai putin de 5 locuri.
Hotel - structura de primire turistica amenajata in cladiri sau in corpuri de cladiri, care pune la dispozitia turistilor camere, garsoniere sau apartamente dotate corespunzator, asigura prestari de servicii specifice si dispune de hol de primire (receptie) si de spatii de alimentatie in incinta.
Hotelurile pentru tineret - structuri de cazare turistica, cu dotari simple, adaptate cerintelor caracteristice tineretului, care asigura servicii de cazare, masa, agrement, pe baza unor regulamente de organizare interioara specifice.
Hostel - structura de primire turistica cu o capacitate minima de 3 camere, garsoniere sau apartamente dispuse pe niveluri, in spatii amenajate, de regula, in cladiri cu alta destinatie initiala decat cea de cazare turistica.
Hotel apartament - acel hotel compus din apartamente sau garsoniere, astfel dotate incat sa asigure pastrarea si prepararea alimentelor, precum si servirea mesei in incinta acestora.
Motel - o unitate de tip hotel situat de obicei in afara oraselor, in apropierea drumurilor cu trafic aglomerat, echipata si amenajata pentru a satisface atat cazare cat si mancare, precum si parcarea in conditii de siguranta a vehiculelor.
Hanuri - local traditional cu ospatarie unde se poate innopta.
Vila turistica - structura de primire turistice de capacitate relativ redusa, functionand in cladiri independente, cu arhitectura specifica, situata in statiuni turistice sau in alte zone si localitati de interes turistic, care asigura cazarea turistilor si prestarea unor servicii specifice.
Cabana turistica - este o unitate de cazare turistica cu o capacitate relativ redusa, care functioneaza in cladiri independente, cu un stil arhitectural specific, care ofera cazare, masa si alte servicii specifice necesare turistilor care fac drumetii sau se odihnesc in zone montane, rezervatii naturale, langa statiuni sau alte atractii turistice.
Cabane de vanatoare si de pescuit - structuri de cazare turistica, de capacitate redusa, amplasate in zone bogate in fond cinegetic si de pescuit, care asigura conditii pentru cazare si servicii suplimentare specifice activitatii.
Bungalouri - unitati de cazare turistica cu capacitate redusa, de obicei din lemn sau materiale similare. Acestea sunt plasate in campinguri, sate de vacanta, ca unitati independente in spa-uri sau zone turistice, sau ca spatii complementare in afara de alte structuri de cazare turistica.
Sat de vacanta - ansamblu de cladiri, de regula vile sau bungalouri, amplasat intr-un perimetru bine delimitat, care asigura turistilor servicii de cazare, de alimentatie si o gama larga de prestatii turistice suplimentare (agrement, sportive, culturale etc.).
Camping  - structuri de cazare turistica destinate sa asigure cazarea turistilor in corturi sau rulote, astfel amenajate incat sa permita acestora sa parcheze mijlocul de transport, sa isi pregateasca masa si sa beneficieze de celelalte servicii specifice acestor tipuri de unitati.
Popas turistic - structura de primire turistica  de capacitate redusa, formata din casute si/sau bungalouri, amplasate dintr-un perimetru bine delimitat, care asigura servicii de cazare si alimentatie precum si posibilitati de parcare auto.
Unitate turistica de tip casuta - un grup independent de casute turistice care are receptie si conducere administrativa comuna.
Tabere de elevi si prescolari - structuri de cazare turistica destinate cazarii elevilor si prescolarilor.
Pensiune turistica - structura de primire turistice, avand o capacitate de cazare de pana la 20 camere, totalizand maxim 60 de locuri, functionand in locuintele cetatenilor sau in cladiri independente, care asigura in spatii special amenajate cazarea turistilor si conditiile de pregatire si servire a mesei.
Pensiunile agroturistice - structuri de primire turistice de capacitate de cazare de pana la 8 camere, functionand in locuintele cetatenilor sau in cladiri independente, care asigura in spatii special amenajate cazarea turistilor  si conditiile de pregatire si servire a mesei, precum si posibilitatea participarii la activitati gospodaresti sau mestesugaresti.
Apartamente sau camere de inchiriat reprezinta structurile de primire turistica cu func?iuni de cazare turistica folosite in exclusivitate pentru cazarea turistilor  indiferent de clasificarea acestora.
Spatii de cazare pe nave maritime si fluviale - spatiile  de cazare turistica de pe navele maritime si fluviale, inclusiv pontoanele plutitoare, care sunt utilizate pentru cazarea turistilor pe durata calatoriei, sau ca hoteluri plutitoare ancorate.
dataset.definition_en:
Establishment of touristic reception with functions of touristic accommodation - any building or settlement which provides permanently or seasonally the tourists with accommodation and other specific services.
The establishments of tourist reception with functions of tourist accommodation with a capacity of less than 5 places are not included in the statistical survey.
Hotel - is a tourist establishment arranged in whole buildings or part of buildings that offers tourists rooms, studios or apartments adequately equipped, provides specific services and has a reception hall (reception) and catering facilities on site.
Youth hotels - are tourist accommodation establishments, simply endowed, adapted to the characteristic requirements of the youth, which provide accommodation, meals and entertainment based on specific internal organizational regulations.
Hostel - is an establishment of tourist reception with a maximum accommodation capacity of 3 rooms, studios or apartments located on different levels, in spaces usually arranged in buildings with other original destination than that of tourist accommodation.
Apartment hotel - is the hotel comprising apartments or studios, equipped to provide preservation and preparation of food and dining on the premises.
Motel - a hotel-type unit usually located outside the towns, near busy traffic roads, equipped and arranged to meet both accommodation and food, and safe parking of vehicles requirements.
Touristic inn - a pub or small local providing food and accomodation.
Tourist villa - is an establishment of tourist reception with relatively low accommodation capacity, operating in independent buildings, with a specific architectural style, located in tourist resorts or in other areas and places of tourist interest which provides tourists with accommodation and certain specific services.
Tourist chalet - is a tourist accommodation establishment with a relatively reduced capacity, operating in independent buildings, with a specific architectural style, which provides accommodation, meals and other specific services necessary to tourists hiking or at rest in mountain areas, nature reserves, near spa resorts or other tourist attractions.
Hunt and fish chalet - is a tourist accommodation establishment, of low capacity, located in areas rich in hunting and fishing stock and which provide accommodation and additional services specific to the respective activity.
Bungalows - are low capacity establishments of tourist accommodation, usually made of wood or similar materials. In damp areas (mountain, sea), they can be made of masonry, too. They generally have seasonal activity.
Holiday Village - is a set of buildings, usually villas and bungalows, located in a well-defined perimeter, providing tourists accommodation, catering and a wide range of additional tourism benefits (entertainment, sports, cultural events, etc.).
Camping - is an accommodation establishment meant to provide tourists accommodation in tents or trailers, designed to allow them to park their means of transport, to prepare their meals and benefit from the other services, specific to these types of units.
Tourist stop - low-capacity tourist reception structure, consisting of houses and / or bungalows, located in a well-defined perimeter, which provides accommodation and food services as well as car parking possibilities.
Tourist cottage - is a tourist accommodation unit with a relatively small capacity, operating in independent buildings with a specific architectural style, which offers accommodation, meals and other services specifically specific to tourists hiking or resting in the mountains, nature reserves , next to spa resorts or other tourist attractions.
Cottage-type tourist unit - is an independent group of cottage-type tourist units with common reception and administrative management.
School and pre-school camps - are tourist accommodation establishments for students and preschoolers.
Tourist pension - tourist reception structure, with an accommodation capacity of up to 20 rooms, totaling a maximum of 60 places, operating in citizens' homes or in independent buildings, which ensure in specially arranged spaces the accommodation of tourists and the conditions of preparation and serving meals.
Agro-tourist boarding houses - is an establishment of tourist reception with an accommodation capacity of up to 8 rooms, in the rural area, operating in the citizens' dwellings or in independent buildings and which provide tourist accommodation and conditions for preparing and serving meals in special set up places and the posibility to attending to the household's activities.
Touristic villas, bungalows and boarding houses - establishments of touristic reception with functions of accommodation, distinct for each building, even if they have the same reception for several villas, bungalows or touristic boarding houses.
Apartments or rooms for rent represent the tourist reception structures with tourist accommodation functions used exclusively for the accommodation of tourists regardless of their classification.
Ships accommodation spaces - Ships and boats, including floating pontoons, which are used to accommodate tourists during the trip or floating hotels ancorate amenities and services they offer.

observations.en:
The number and name of localities are in accordance with administrative territorial structure updated for current year.
The content of data, for 1990-2000, is: total, of witch, for categories of units. There are distinguish only few categories of units.
The territorial directions  of statistics may make changes to the data for localities investigated last year, but without affecting the county totals and the types of establishments of touristic reception with functions of tourists accommodation.
In the data series ''the urban boarding houses''  have redefined in ''tourist boarding houses'', and  agro-tourist boarding houses include rural and agro-tourist boarding houses; ''hunting chalets'' and ''fishing chalets'' are assimilated ''touristic chalets''.
Until 2000 the inns and motels were followed cumulatively.
Start with 2009 ''hotels for youth'' are assimilated ''hostels''.
National Institute of Statistics collects annually statistical data about the tourism accommodation establishments with an existing capacity of 5 bed-places and more.
The data available for 2021 and 2022 are revised compared to those previously published, as a result of the inclusion of the arrivals and overnight stays of tourists staying in apartments and rooms for rent.
observations.ro:
Numarul si denumirile localitatilor Romaniei sunt in concordanta cu impartirea administrativ - teritoriala revizuita in anul curent.
Continutul seriilor de date, 1990-2000, pentru categorii de unitati este: total, din care. Se evidentiaza numai anumite categorii de unitati la nivel de localitate.
Directiile teritoriale de statistica pot face modificari la datele pe localitati pentru ultimul an cercetat, fara insa a afecta totalurile pe judet si tipuri de structuri de primire turistica cu functiuni de cazare.
In seriile de date ''pensiunile urbane'' s-au redefinit in ''pensiuni turistice'', iar pensiunile agroturistice cuprind pensiunile rurale si cele agroturistice; ''cabanele de vanatoare'' si ''cabanele de pescuit '' se asimileaza ''cabanelor turistice''.
Pana in anul 2000 hanurile si motelurile s-au urmarit cumulate.
Incepand cu anul 2009 ''hotelurile pentru tineret'' se asimileaza ''hostelurilor''.
Anual INS colecteaza date statistice de la structurile de cazare turistica cu o capacitate de cazare existenta de minim 5 locuri-pat si peste.
Datele disponibile pentru anul 2021 si 2022 sunt revizuite fata de cele publicate anterior, ca urmare a includerii sosirilor si innoptarilor turistilor cazati in apartamente si camere de inchiriat.

methodologies.en: The number of tourist accommodation units includes the existing units at the end of the respective year, until 1993, and starting with 1994, the existing units on July 31 of that year, exclusively the units whose activity was interrupted for a longer period in in order to carry out capital repairs or for important changes of the accommodation capacity and / or the classification category. Tourist villas, bungalows and boarding houses are establishments of tourist accommodation which are distinct for each building, even if several villas, bungalows or boarding houses share the same reception. The houselet-type unit includes tourist houselets which are not complementary to other types of tourist accommodation establishments (camping, hotel etc.), with the same reception and administrative management.This type of establishment is distinctly registered since 1994 being previously included in the campings. Metadata and quality report
methodologies.ro: In numarul unitatilor de cazare turistica sint cuprinse unitatile existente la sfirsitul anului respectiv, pina in 1993, iar incepind cu anul 1994, unitatile existente la 31 iulie din anul respectiv, exclusiv unitatile a caror activitate a fost intrerupta pentru o perioada mai mare de timp in vederea realizarii unor reparatii capitale sau pentru modificari importante ale capacitatii de cazare sau/ si categoriei de incadrare. Vilele turistice, bungalourile si pensiunile turistice se constituie ca unitati de cazare turistica distincte pentru fiecare cladire in parte chiar daca au o receptie comuna la mai multe vile, bungalouri sau pensiuni. Unitatea de tip casuta include casutele turistice care nu sunt complementare la un alt tip de structura de primire turistica cu functiuni de cazare ( camping, hotel etc.), cu o receptie si o conducere administrativa comuna. Acest tip de structura se urmareste distinct din anul 1994, iar anterior acestui an au fost cuprinse la campinguri. Raport de metadate si calitate
